strongly_regular_parameters.note: k-regular, exactly lam common neighbours for every adjacent pair, exactly mu for every pair of distinct non-adjacent vertices; no guard (parameters are not functions of degenerate graphs).

has_strongly_regular_parameters.note: some parameters, unguarded: accepts K_2, the empty graph, complete, edgeless and clique-union graphs.

connected_nontrivial_strongly_regular.note: some parameters of a connected graph with 0 < k < #|G|.-1 (nat predecessor: at least three vertices); excludes K_2 and the degenerate graphs; K_{2,2} is in.

strongly_regular_matrix_identity.note: A^2 = k I + lam A + mu (J - I - A) for the integer adjacency matrix indexed by enum_val; equivalent to the counting clauses for all parameters.

connected_nontrivial_strongly_regular_ma.note: the matrix identity with the same three guards; equivalent to connected_nontrivial_strongly_regular.
